open_questions: Period aliases/continuation beyond 2 detected sectors S50/S77 need confirmation with additional transits/timestamps

Low SNR (11.6, 3 transits) leaves alternative models not ruled out with high significance; centroid remains inconclusive due to low SNR difference image, so direct on-target confirmation via ground-based photometry at transit ephemeris would secure it
Marginal secondary detection (snr 4.19 depth 2263 ppm at phase 0.3837, depth_over_dip 0.2547) needs higher-SNR follow-up to confirm absence of occultation
dossier.public_summary: A ~3-hour, ~0.9% flat-bottomed dip repeats every 14.3 days on a small M dwarf with no odd/even difference or clear secondary and no nearby star that could mimic it, giving a ~3.8 Earth-radius candidate. The signal is weak with only three transits, which makes confirmation difficult, but the shape and lack of binary signs make a planet the best current explanation.

reasons.why: Flat-bottomed (negative v_sigma) with duration a little long but consistent with a short separable, near-central transit on a cool dwarf; positive star_density_penalty does not produce a density mismatch for a central duration given the stellar density uncertainty. No V-shape to favour grazing binary.
reasons.value: v_sigma -2.712, duration ratio 1.315 (central 2.281 h vs observed 3 h; stellar_radius 0.366/0.406/0.415 Rsun gives ratio 1.32/1.18/1.16)

reasons.why: Odd/even depths equal and no secondary eclipse at high significance (secondary snr <5 and not above significant brightening); no evidence for EB at twice period despite secondary near threshold.
reasons.value: odd_even diff_sigma 0.1846 depth 8645 vs 8941 ppm; secondary snr 4.19 vs best_brightening snr 2.911 depth_over_dip 0.2547

reasons.why: Planet size is super-Earth/mini-Neptune below 10 Re, flat and odd-even consistent with planet. No star within a TESS pixel that could plausibly cause the 9163 ppm dip, so a nearby blended EB is ruled out even though centroid difference image is inconclusive (centroid_all not_run).
reasons.value: rp_rearth 3.82 (undiluted 9176 ppm, Rp/R* 0.09579); neighbours plausible_within_1px 0, could_cause_within_1px 0; centroid inconclusive with 0 could_cause within 1 px and 3 transits

reasons.why: Only 3 transits at SNR ~11-12 is low and drives low planet_rank, but transits themselves are depth-consistent and not from a few outliers (share 0.482, top-3 share 1.0). Low rank reflects strength, not type; no other check favours binary/variability (sectors p_constant 0.1738, phase_curve ratio 0.096 chi2 14.6/9), so low SNR is noted but does not change that planet is best explanation.
reasons.value: refit snr 11.23 with 3 transits, share 0.482, transit_depths p_consistent 0.2475; xgboost planet_rank 0.12
